chunks: Yet they hasten to follow in their footsteps.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when people hasten in the footsteps of others?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Ad-Dukhan highlights the urgency of the disbelievers in Mecca who, upon hearing the Prophet Muhammad's call, rushed to emulate the traditions of their forefathers or the Prophet's own earlier practices before prophethood. It underscores the concept of *taqlid* (blind imitation) and the haste with which they sought to reject the new divine message by clinging to established, albeit flawed, precedents.
